notes: A Proxy-Authorization header set on the initial request leaked to the destination server when a redirect crossed to an HTTPS origin. Only reachable when redirects are followed (the default) and a proxy header is in play. rebuild_proxies is the function the fix changed; resolve_redirects is its only caller and the realistic path from user code.
reviewer_note: Because resolve_redirects runs inside Session.send, almost any requests call reaches this - a good example of a finding that is genuinely reachable but low impact without a proxy.
